title: Restriction of intrinsic ordinary proper/open alpha
statement:
Let $B$ be a commutative ring. For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], use the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the constant ring sheaf $\underline B_X$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and its module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $P_f$ for the specified inverse image [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], $L_j$ for open extension [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension], and $\eta_j:1\cong P_jL_j$ for its specified open-adjunction unit. Set $\epsilon_j=\eta_j^{-1}$. Let $k:V\to W$ and $i:S\to T$ be quasi-compact open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $r:V\to S$ and $p:W\to T$ be proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism] with $pk=ir$. Let $\sigma:P_rP_i\cong P_kP_p$ be the specified inverse-image square comparison [lem-cbc-tower-open-beta-normalization] and let $\alpha:P_pL_i\to L_kP_r$ be the actual ordinary clopen-factor construction [def-cbc-strict-tower-ordinary-proper-open-arrows]. For every module sheaf $M$ on $S$,
$$\epsilon_{k,P_rM}\circ P_k(\alpha_M)=P_r(\epsilon_{i,M})\circ\sigma^{-1}_{L_iM}.$$
No cartesianness of the square is assumed.

proof.text: Factor the square through W times_T S. Let s be its clopen lift, b the first projection, and q the second. Write kappa_k and kappa_r for inverse-image composition with the equalities sb=k and sq=r. Apply moduleCompEq_coherence twice, to s,b,p and s,q,i, and expand moduleSquareG_eq. Cancel the common total compositor. This identifies kappa_r, restriction along s of the cartesian square, and inverse kappa_k with the original square comparison.

The open compositor preserves adjunction units because it is the left-adjoint comparison conjugate to the inverse-image compositor. Apply unit_conjugateEquiv to its inverse and substitute k=sb. This gives the unit equation required for the factored open extension.

The clopen projector theorem gives P_s(pi_s)=unit_s on P_s of an arbitrary module. The normalized beta theorem, via the open adjunction hom equivalence, gives unit_b followed by P_b(beta inverse) equal to P_q(unit_i) followed by the inverse cartesian square comparison.

Expand the alpha factor word on a module. First restrict the section/projector/open-compositor part: naturality of the inverse open unit moves the inverse-image compositor out, the open-unit composition identity replaces the open compositor, and restriction of the projector cancels the remaining unit. Transport this identity along sb=k and sq=r. For the beta part, move the inverse-image compositor past beta by naturality, use its one-square restriction equation, then move the second compositor past the inverse open unit. The square-factor identity gives exactly the inverse outer square comparison. Combine these two strictly shorter restriction calculations, and specialize the factorization to the pullback and its clopen lift.

lean.statement:
theorem singleAlpha_restriction {V W S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : Modules B S) :
    (modulePullback B k).map ((singleAlpha B k r p i h).app M) ≫
        (moduleOpenUnitInv B k).app ((modulePullback B r).obj M) =
      (moduleSquareG B k r p i h).inv.app ((moduleJ B i).obj M) ≫
        (modulePullback B r).map ((moduleOpenUnitInv B i).app M)
